title: feat(port): slice 134 — g.j grab latch + default e() arm + S146/S147 wall sequence
body:
## Summary

Ports the `g.j` static latch plus the `e()` `default:` arm and the S146/S147 wall-pass sequence — all verbatim from `g.java`.

- **`g.j` → `Entity.grabLatch`** (g.java:60): set by the S146/S147 arms (:2865/:2898), cleared by `i.D()` entity-pool init (i.java:1817/:1977 → our `teardown()`), read by the default arm's `r() && !j` fall guard and the (still-unported) mount gates at i.java:7180/:15564.
- **`default:` arm** (g.java:1145-1147) replaces the slice-2 "settle to 0/43" inference: `if (r() && !j && !l() && !j) a(0)` — `a(0)` is `g.a(int)` = `flingAirborne(0)`. The doubled `!j` is verbatim (`l()` runs between the reads). `!l()` only passes when `l()` leaves the state untouched — for non-79 states that's `ax()`'s airborne-no-support return, so the fling is the airborne-held-dir case, while grounded+no-input folds `i(11)` first (original ordering preserved).
- **`case 146`** (g.java:2859-2884): `ag=±2048` wall-drive; `r() || (av?aT!=3:aU!=3)` → `al+=20; i(147); j=true`.
- **`case 147`** (g.java:2885-2918): vel0; on `r()` — latch, `k.bG = k.x() ? k.bH : -1` (→ `musicActive()`/`kBg`/`kBH`, `inferred` audio mapping), `k.A(18)`, `k.a(true)` (→ `resetLevel`/`reload`, `inferred`), `k.az = readShort(bA,32)` (→ `kBA[32]`). Dead conjunct `S==145` kept verbatim — S is 147.
- New `LevelCellSource` members `kBg`/`kBH`/`kBA`/`musicActive()`/`resetLevel(full)` with safe defaults; `MarkerWorld` opened for stub subclassing.

7 new `Slice134Test` cases pin the latch gating, the S146→S147 handoff, and the S147 transition reset (streak restore + music slot). Gates: verifier `ok:true`, 57 unittests, `:core:test`, `:android:assembleDebug`, `:gdx:build` all green.
